mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO index drops > 2% MoM but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales rise together, it signals a broad-based strengthening of consumer demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS rise MoM but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8%, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 8% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and core CPI inflation is above 3%, it signals a monetary policy regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as real yields collapse.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is rising and the unemployment rate is falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.
